result:
The decisive mistake was identifying the wrong OpenCV version. The task asks about the version where Mask-RCNN support was added, which is not 4.1.2. The plan in step 0 fixed on 4.1.2 without checking, and every later step compared contributors from that wrong release. That is why no match with a former Chinese head of government was found, instead of the expected "Li Peng".
